headlineVariants.headline: Business Operations Analyst · Process Optimization · Workflow Automation
Workflow Solutions Engineer · Automation Architecture · Integrations

profileVariants.text: Results-oriented Business Operations Analyst with 5+ years of experience streamlining complex processes and shipping production automations across international teams. Combines structured BPMN process mapping, API integrations, and hands-on scripting to reduce manual toil and elevate reporting precision.

achievementsPool: Redesigned multi-department ticket dispatch workflows, cutting end-to-end turnaround time by 65%.
Built and standardized an operational knowledge repository of 100+ SOPs adopted across 8 regional teams.
Automated recurring financial variance reporting scripts, eliminating 15 hours of manual spreadsheet work weekly.

bullets: Mapped and standardized cross-departmental operations flows across 8 European regions using BPMN standards.
Engineered automated ticket escalation workflows in n8n and REST APIs, improving first-response SLAs by **45%**.
Authored and published over 60 Standard Operating Procedures in a central operational repository.
Built automated Python data sync routines between CRM and internal PostgreSQL data warehouses.
Audited order-fulfillment bottlenecks and implemented root-cause remediation workflows.
Automated daily shipping variance dashboards, reducing manual spreadsheet reporting by **12 hours weekly**.
Facilitated cross-functional alignment sessions between operations, finance, and logistics leads.
